name: Terraform Security Review
description: Security review of Terraform and OpenTofu configurations and state. Covers HCL code review for misconfigurations, state file security, provider credential management, module supply chain risks, and evaluation of Terraform-provisioned infrastructure against security baselines.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Terraform security review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Terraform concepts, HCL syntax, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain Terraform providers, resources, state files, and modules
Understands common Terraform misconfigurations that lead to security issues
Familiar with Terraform state file sensitivity and backend security

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Terraform configurations under supervision using static analysis tools
evidence: Runs Terraform security scanning tools (e.g., Trivy (formerly tfsec), Checkov, KICS) under guidance
Identifies common misconfigurations in HCL code using lab checklists
Documents Terraform security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews Terraform codebases for security misconfigurations and risks
evidence: Independently reviews Terraform configurations across multiple providers
Evaluates state file security (backend encryption, access controls, secret exposure)
Identifies security risks in module dependencies and provider configurations
Produces compliant Terraform security review reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-provider Terraform reviews; develops custom policies; mentors others
evidence: Reviews complex multi-provider, multi-workspace Terraform codebases
Develops custom policy rules for Terraform security scanning tools
Reviews Terraform security work of junior analysts
Evaluates Terraform CI/CD pipeline security (plan-time vs apply-time controls)

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Terraform review methodology; publishes research on IaC security
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Terraform security review framework
Published research on Terraform security risks or novel misconfiguration patterns
Trains teams on advanced Terraform security review
Recognized as authority on Terraform and HCL security

assessment_methods.description: Review a Terraform codebase with intentional misconfigurations and identify all security issues
Review Terraform security findings from recent IaC assessment engagements

cis: CIS AWS, Azure and GCP Foundations Benchmarks as scan baselines
